name: mymind
soft_passes: #2 grid: optically centred, sits a hair low; precise placement unverifiable at 102px
#3 silhouette: reads as a hunched figure/creature but deliberately abstract, not a crisp metaphor
#4 16px squint: smears to an orange blob, figure detail lost but high-contrast brand-colour mark survives
#12 no-text: no words/UI, but a photoreal CGI render (against HIG vector/illustration preference)
failures: #10 variant robustness: not authored as Icon Composer light/dark/tinted/mono layers; flocked form-shaded render leans on the white ground and has no flat silhouette to survive mono/tinted

palette.accent: none (the orange figure is the identity)

light_model: single soft top-front warm key; diffuse rim highlight on crown/shoulders, ambient-occlusion baked into crevices/underside; matte flocked surface (no hard specular); subtle contact shadow, system supplies the drop shadow
devices: single-hue orange object floating on pure white
rhymes_hint: rendered-3D-object icons (clay/blob/soft-render trend, matte single-hue material on plain ground) and brand-mascot/character icons; style-family 'tactile mascot-object on white', palette-family warm orange/coral ramps
notes: Source is only a 102x102 compressed WebP (smallest in corpus) — texture/edge/micro-shadow below resolution floor, palette hexes indicative (estimated) not measured. Square white field bleeds to edge, no baked mask (system squircle applies cleanly). No diagonal tool, no gradient background field — anti-Big-Sur, custom brand-render era. Cover confirms strong brand coherence: same egg-headed figure appears as a minimal line glyph in marketing, so the brand already owns a flat-silhouette variant that would fix the #10 mono weakness but isn't the shipped icon.
